matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Offense vs. Pass Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass offense grades in the 97th percentile against a unit that grades 71st — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about this week: we're staring down the widest statistical edge on the board — our pass offense in the 97th percentile going up against Pittsburgh's 71st-percentile pass defense — and yet we're still favored by just 5.5 points at home, which tells you everything about how messy this matchup feels. The Steelers are rolling with that league-average offense (ranked 21st) and a legitimately stout defense (14th), and while we have the weapons to light them up through the air, there's the small matter of potentially being without Carlton Davis III at corner, the kind of detail that can swing a game when you're facing one of the NFL's toughest defensive minds. TreVeyon Henderson says he's ready to go, which is excellent news for our run game, and we've got recent history on our side — wins in three of our last five meetings — but we can't ignore that Week 1 stumble or the fact that the Steelers have been the steadier team lately. This is precisely the kind of game where our schematic advantage in the passing game has to translate into points, because defensive soundness has a way of overcoming statistical edge in these rivalry matchups.
